messages:
lucas (support): FYI escalated from CustCorp — after they scaled down a nodepool the Dedicated dashboard for cluster custcorp-eu-west-1 shows zero GPU rows and capacity mismatch. Customer is seeing allocation errors. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/inventory/cluster/custcorp-eu-west-1 :rotating_light:

jess (oncall-sre): looking. do we have an incident ticket? any quick repro steps?

ops-escalation-bot: Created INC-2026-5123 for CustCorp escalation. Priority: P2. Assigned: jess, mike.

mike (infra): I’ve seen this when inventory cache doesn’t pick up node label changes after scale-down. can you paste the inventory API response and a kubectl node list?

lucas (support): attaching quick outputs — minimal redaction:
```
$ kubectl get nodes -l redwood.cluster=custcorp-eu-west-1 -o wide
NAME                          STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION
node-35-custcorp-1            Ready    gpu      10d   v1.28.4
node-36-custcorp-2            Ready    gpu      10d   v1.28.4

$ kubectl get pods -n redwood-inventory
NAME                                   READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inventory-sync-5f6d7c8d9-abcde        1/1     Running   0          3d
```

lucas (support): inventory API call returned empty set for that cluster: 
```
GET /v1/dedicated/inventory?cluster=custcorp-eu-west-1
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
[]
```

jess (oncall-sre): ok that matches. likely the cache/lookup key changed during the scale op. immediate mitigation: trigger a reindex of inventory for that cluster and check the sync job logs. can someone run the admin reindex?

mike (infra): running reindex now. command:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/admin/reindex-inventory \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"cluster":"custcorp-eu-west-1"}'
```

mike (infra): logs show reindex worker picked up the job, processing objects... patching 2 node entries, rebuilding GPU rows. ETA ~30s

sre-bot: Reindex job 8791 finished for cluster custcorp-eu-west-1. nodes_seen=2 gpus_registered=8 duration_ms=2450

lucas (support): customer confirms dashboard now shows 2 nodes and 8 GPUs, apps resumed allocation. they asked what caused this so we can avoid repeats.

anita (product): thanks. sounds like a sync edge-case on scale-down where label/owner keys temporarily diverge. can we add a post-action hook to kick reindex after nodepool scale events? also flag for runbook update and customer note.

mike (infra): noted. quick root cause theory: when nodepool controller removes nodes it updates node labels in two stages; inventory cache looks up by label set A, our selector was using label set B after the move. reindex fixes, but we should patch selector + add an event-triggered reindex. filing infra ticket INF-2026-789 to change selector fallback and add webhook.

jess (oncall-sre): adding a short runbook step for oncall: if dedicated inventory shows empty after cluster change — 1) check inventory API, 2) run reindex, 3) confirm nodes_seen via sync logs, 4) escalate to infra if reindex fails.

lucas (support): customer happy, closing the support escalation after they acknowledged. will follow up with customer note and link to runbook. :white_check_mark:

mike (infra): will push the infra ticket and prototype the scale-event hook. leaving follow-up in INF-2026-789.

jess (oncall-sre): closing INC-2026-5123, marking as resolved. will reopen if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:

lucas (support): thanks everyone. postmortem requested if this reoccurs.
